2126351487798317409.en_summary: Jordan: Alice Huang's classification as a "spy" is so beyond the point of why $NVDA is a problem (for the markets and national security) that wont go away with Huang being back as CEO. But let's delve into the issues surrounding Trump's "setting the record straight." You and he would like sentient humans to believe the most sophisticated surveillance state in the history of mankind, created by the ruthless CCP, DID NOT TURN into an asset, a Chinese national, one who is part of China Inc (and reports to the party) and one who is banging the top CEO of its top global adversary? Good luck with that one pal. Quoting: Charles, the story that led to his initial ouster had nothing to do with capitalism. It was an anonymously sourced hit job citing "national security" that turned out to be false. It is the president's right to set the record straight. Nvidia listened to shareholders when they reinstated Jensen. That is capitalism to a tee.
2126351487798317409.zh_summary: Jordan：Alice Huang 被歸類為「間諜」遠超出了為什麼 $NVDA 是一個問題（對市場和國家安全）的點，不會隨著 Huang 重新擔任 CEO 而消失。但讓我們深入探討圍繞特朗普「澄清事實」的問題。你和他想讓有感知的人類相信，人類歷史上最複雜的監控國家，由無情的中共創建，沒有變成資產，一個中國公民，一個是中國公司的一部分（並向黨報告），一個正在與它的頂級全球對手的頂級 CEO 交往？祝你好運，朋友。引用：Charles，導致他最初被罷免的故事與資本主義無關。這是一個匿名來源的打擊工作，引用「國家安全」，結果證明是假的。總統有權澄清事實。Nvidia 在重新任命 Jensen 時聽取了股東的意見。那才是真正的資本主義。
